records.title: TCFF-Adapter: Text-Driven Adaption of CLIP for Few-Shot Image Classification
records.reason: TCFF-Adapter improves few-shot CLIP image classification through cross-modal feature fusion; no LLM inference or serving optimization is presented.

records.title: LF-SSM: Lightweight HiPPO-Free State Space Model for Real-Time UAV Tracking
records.reason: LF-SSM targets real-time UAV object tracking on edge platforms. It is an SSM efficiency application, but not a language-model inference or serving contribution.
